collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2012 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLA Coupe 2012 to 2015 (117) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
